verses.original: נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֣ר מַלְכָּ֗א עֲבַד֙ צְלֵ֣ם דִּֽי־ דְהַ֔ב רוּמֵהּ֙ אַמִּ֣ין שִׁתִּ֔ין פְּתָיֵ֖הּ אַמִּ֣ין שִׁ֑ת אֲקִימֵהּ֙ בְּבִקְעַ֣ת דּוּרָ֔א בִּמְדִינַ֖ת בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar mal·kā ‘ă·ḇaḏ ṣə·lêm dî- ḏə·haḇ rū·mêh ’am·mîn šit·tîn pə·ṯā·yêh ’am·mîn šiṯ ’ă·qî·mêh bə·ḇiq·‘aṯ dū·rā bim·ḏî·naṯ bā·ḇel
verses.literal: King Nebuchadnezzar made a golden statue . . . sixty cubits high and six cubits wide and he set it up on the plain of Dura in the province of Babylon
verses.literalPt: O REI Nabucodonosor fez uma estátua de ouro, cuja altura era de sessenta côvados, e a sua largura de seis côvados; levantou-a no campo de Dura, na província de Babilônia.

verses.original: וּנְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֣ר מַלְכָּ֡א שְׁלַ֡ח לְמִכְנַ֣שׁ׀ לַֽאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֡א סִגְנַיָּ֣א וּֽפַחֲוָתָ֡א אֲדַרְגָּזְרַיָּא֩ גְדָ֨בְרַיָּ֤א דְּתָבְרַיָּא֙ תִּפְתָּיֵ֔א וְכֹ֖ל שִׁלְטֹנֵ֣י מְדִֽינָתָ֑א לְמֵתֵא֙ לַחֲנֻכַּ֣ת צַלְמָ֔א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ים נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֥ר מַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar mal·kā šə·laḥ lə·miḵ·naš la·’ă·ḥaš·dar·pə·nay·yā siḡ·nay·yā ū·p̄a·ḥă·wā·ṯā ’ă·ḏar·gā·zə·ray·yā ḡə·ḏā·ḇə·ray·yā də·ṯā·ḇə·ray·yā tip̄·tā·yê wə·ḵōl šil·ṭō·nê mə·ḏî·nā·ṯā lə·mê·ṯê la·ḥă·nuk·kaṯ ṣal·mā dî hă·qêm nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar mal·kā
verses.literal: Then King Nebuchadnezzar sent word to assemble the satraps prefects governors advisers treasurers judges magistrates and all the other officials of the provinces to attend the dedication of the statue . . . he . . . had set up
verses.literalPt: Então o rei Nabucodonosor mandou reunir os príncipes, os prefeitos, os governadores, os conselheiros, os tesoureiros, os juízes, os capitães, e todos os oficiais das províncias, para que viessem à consagração da estátua que o rei Nabucodonosor tinha levantado.

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֡יִן מִֽתְכַּנְּשִׁ֡ין אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֡א סִגְנַיָּ֣א וּֽפַחֲוָתָ֡א אֲדַרְגָּזְרַיָּ֣א גְדָבְרַיָּא֩ דְּתָ֨בְרַיָּ֜א תִּפְתָּיֵ֗א וְכֹל֙ שִׁלְטֹנֵ֣י מְדִֽינָתָ֔א לַחֲנֻכַּ֣ת צַלְמָ֔א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ים נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֣ר מַלְכָּ֑א וְקָאֲמִין לָקֳבֵ֣ל צַלְמָ֔א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ים נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin miṯ·kan·nə·šîn ’ă·ḥaš·dar·pə·nay·yā siḡ·nay·yā ū·p̄a·ḥă·wā·ṯā ’ă·ḏar·gā·zə·ray·yā ḡə·ḏā·ḇə·ray·yā də·ṯā·ḇə·ray·yā tip̄·tā·yê wə·ḵōl šil·ṭō·nê mə·ḏî·nā·ṯā la·ḥă·nuk·kaṯ ṣal·mā dî hă·qêm nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar mal·kā wə·qå̄·ʾă·mīn lā·qo·ḇêl ṣal·mā dî hă·qêm nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar
verses.literal: So the satraps prefects governors advisers treasurers judges magistrates and all the rulers of the provinces assembled for the dedication of the statue that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up and they stood before it . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Então se reuniram os príncipes, os prefeitos e governadores, os capitães, os juízes, os tesoureiros, os conselheiros, e todos os oficiais das províncias, à consagração da estátua que o rei Nabucodonosor tinha levantado; e estavam em pé diante da imagem que Nabucodonosor tinha levantado.

verses.original: וְכָרוֹזָ֖א קָרֵ֣א בְחָ֑יִל לְכ֤וֹן אָֽמְרִין֙ עַֽמְמַיָּ֔א אֻמַּיָּ֖א וְלִשָּׁנַיָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵā·rō·w·zā qā·rê ḇə·ḥā·yil lə·ḵō·wn ’ā·mə·rîn ‘am·may·yā ’um·may·yā wə·liš·šā·nay·yā
verses.literal: Then the herald loudly proclaimed O people of every nation and language this is what you are commanded
verses.literalPt: E o arauto apregoava em alta voz: Ordena-se a vós, ó povos, nações e línguas:

verses.original: בְּעִדָּנָ֡א דִּֽי־ תִשְׁמְע֡וּן קָ֣ל קַרְנָ֣א מַ֠שְׁרוֹקִיתָא קִיתָרוֹס סַבְּכָ֤א פְּסַנְתֵּרִין֙ סוּמְפֹּ֣נְיָ֔ה וְכֹ֖ל זְנֵ֣י זְמָרָ֑א תִּפְּל֤וּן וְתִסְגְּדוּן֙ לְצֶ֣לֶם דַּהֲבָ֔א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ים נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֥ר מַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: bə·‘id·dā·nā dî- ṯiš·mə·‘ūn qāl qar·nā maš·rō·w·qî·ṯā qī·ṯå̄·rōs sab·bə·ḵā pə·san·tê·rîn sū·mə·pō·nə·yāh wə·ḵōl zə·nê zə·mā·rā tip·pə·lūn wə·ṯis·gə·ḏūn lə·ṣe·lem da·hă·ḇā dî hă·qêm nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar mal·kā
verses.literal: As soon as . . . you hear the sound of the horn flute zither lyre harp pipes and all kinds of music you must fall down and worship the golden . . . statue that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up
verses.literalPt: Quando ouvirdes o som da buzina, da flauta, da harpa, da sambuca, do saltério, da gaita de foles, e de toda a espécie de música, prostrar-vos-eis, e adorareis a estátua de ouro que o rei Nabucodonosor tem levantado.

verses.original: וּמַן־ דִּי־ לָ֥א יִפֵּ֖ל וְיִסְגֻּ֑ד בַּהּ־ שַׁעֲתָ֣א יִתְרְמֵ֔א לְגֽוֹא־ אַתּ֥וּן נוּרָ֖א יָקִֽדְתָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ū·man- dî- lā yip·pêl wə·yis·guḏ bah- ša·‘ă·ṯā yiṯ·rə·mê lə·ḡō·w- ’at·tūn nū·rā yā·qiḏ·tā
verses.literal: And whoever . . . does not fall down and worship will immediately be thrown into the blazing fiery furnace
verses.literalPt: E qualquer que não se prostrar e não a adorar, será na mesma hora lançado dentro da fornalha de fogo ardente.

verses.original: כָּל־ קֳבֵ֣ל דְּנָ֡ה בֵּהּ־ זִמְנָ֡א כְּדִ֣י שָֽׁמְעִ֣ין כָּֽל־ עַמְמַיָּ֡א קָ֣ל קַרְנָא֩ מַשְׁר֨וֹקִיתָ֜א קִיתָרֹס שַׂבְּכָא֙ פְּסַנְטֵרִ֔ין וְכֹ֖ל זְנֵ֣י זְמָרָ֑א נָֽפְלִ֨ין כָּֽל־ עַֽמְמַיָּ֜א אֻמַיָּ֣א וְלִשָּׁנַיָּ֗א סָֽגְדִין֙ לְצֶ֣לֶם דַּהֲבָ֔א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ים נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֥ר מַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- qo·ḇêl də·nāh bêh- zim·nā kə·ḏî šā·mə·‘în kāl- ‘am·may·yā qāl qar·nā maš·rō·w·qî·ṯā qī·ṯå̄·rōs śab·bə·ḵā pə·san·ṭê·rîn wə·ḵōl zə·nê zə·mā·rā nā·p̄ə·lîn kāl- ‘am·may·yā ’u·may·yā wə·liš·šā·nay·yā sā·ḡə·ḏîn lə·ṣe·lem da·hă·ḇā dî hă·qêm nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar mal·kā
verses.literal: Therefore as soon as all the people heard the sound of the horn flute zither lyre harp and all kinds of music the people of every nation and language would fall down and worship the golden statue that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up
verses.literalPt: Portanto, no mesmo instante em que todos os povos ouviram o som da buzina, da flauta, da harpa, da sambuca, do saltério e de toda a espécie de música, prostraram-se todos os povos, nações e línguas, e adoraram a estátua de ouro que o rei Nabucodonosor tinha levantado.

verses.original: כָּל־ קֳבֵ֤ל דְּנָה֙ בֵּהּ־ זִמְנָ֔א קְרִ֖בוּ גֻּבְרִ֣ין כַּשְׂדָּאִ֑ין וַאֲכַ֥לוּ קַרְצֵיה֖וֹן דִּ֥י יְהוּדָיֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- qo·ḇêl də·nāh bêh- zim·nā qə·ri·ḇū guḇ·rîn kaś·dā·’în wa·’ă·ḵa·lū qar·ṣê·hō·wn dî yə·hū·ḏā·yê
verses.literal: At this time . . . some astrologers came forward . . . and maliciously accused . . . the Jews
verses.literalPt: Por isso, no mesmo instante chegaram perto alguns caldeus, e acusaram os judeus.

verses.original: עֲנוֹ֙ וְאָ֣מְרִ֔ין לִנְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֖ר מַלְכָּ֑א מַלְכָּ֖א לְעָלְמִ֥ין חֱיִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·nōw wə·’ā·mə·rîn lin·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar mal·kā mal·kā lə·‘ā·lə·mîn ḥĕ·yî
verses.literal: saying . . . to King Nebuchadnezzar O king may you live forever
verses.literalPt: E responderam, dizendo ao rei Nabucodonosor: Ó rei, vive eternamente!

verses.original: אַנְתָּה מַלְכָּא֮ שָׂ֣מְתָּ טְּעֵם֒ דִּ֣י כָל־ אֱנָ֡שׁ דִּֽי־ יִשְׁמַ֡ע קָ֣ל קַרְנָ֣א מַ֠שְׁרֹקִיתָא קִיתָרֹס שַׂבְּכָ֤א פְסַנְתֵּרִין֙ וְסִיפֹּנְיָה וְכֹ֖ל זְנֵ֣י זְמָרָ֑א יִפֵּ֥ל וְיִסְגֻּ֖ד לְצֶ֥לֶם דַּהֲבָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ʾan·tå̄h mal·kā śā·mə·tā ṭə·‘êm dî ḵāl ’ĕ·nāš dî- yiš·ma‘ qāl qar·nā maš·rō·qî·ṯā qī·ṯå̄·rōs śab·bə·ḵā p̄ə·san·tê·rîn wə·sī·pō·nə·yå̄h wə·ḵōl zə·nê zə·mā·rā yip·pêl wə·yis·guḏ lə·ṣe·lem da·hă·ḇā
verses.literal: You O king have issued a decree that everyone . . . who hears the sound of the horn flute zither lyre harp pipes and all kinds of music must fall down and worship the golden statue
verses.literalPt: Tu, ó rei, fizeste um decreto, pelo qual todo homem que ouvisse o som da buzina, da flauta, da harpa, da sambuca, do saltério, e da gaita de foles, e de toda a espécie de música, se prostrasse e adorasse a estátua de ouro;

verses.original: וּמַן־ דִּי־ לָ֥א יִפֵּ֖ל וְיִסְגֻּ֑ד יִתְרְמֵ֕א לְגֽוֹא־ אַתּ֥וּן נוּרָ֖א יָקִֽדְתָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ū·man- dî- lā yip·pêl wə·yis·guḏ yiṯ·rə·mê lə·ḡō·w- ’at·tūn nū·rā yā·qiḏ·tā
verses.literal: and that whoever . . . does not fall down and worship will be thrown into the blazing fiery furnace
verses.literalPt: E, qualquer que não se prostrasse e adorasse, seria lançado dentro da fornalha de fogo ardente.

verses.original: אִיתַ֞י גֻּבְרִ֣ין יְהוּדָאיִ֗ן דִּֽי־ מַנִּ֤יתָ יָתְהוֹן֙ עַל־ עֲבִידַת֙ מְדִינַ֣ת בָּבֶ֔ל שַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֖ךְ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֑וֹ גֻּבְרַיָּ֣א אִלֵּ֗ךְ לָא־ שָׂ֨מֽוּ עֲלַיִךְ מַלְכָּא֙ טְעֵ֔ם לֵאלָהַיִךְ לָ֣א פָלְחִ֔ין וּלְצֶ֧לֶם דַּהֲבָ֛א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ימְתָּ לָ֥א סָגְדִֽין׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’î·ṯay guḇ·rîn yə·hū·ḏā·yin dî- man·nî·ṯā yā·ṯə·hō·wn ‘al- ‘ă·ḇî·ḏaṯ mə·ḏî·naṯ bā·ḇel šaḏ·raḵ mê·šaḵ wa·‘ă·ḇêḏ nə·ḡōw guḇ·ray·yā ’il·lêḵ lā- śā·mū ʿă·la·yiḵ mal·kā ṭə·‘êm lē·lå̄·ha·yiḵ lā p̄ā·lə·ḥîn ū·lə·ṣe·lem da·hă·ḇā dî hă·qê·mə·tā lā sā·ḡə·ḏîn
verses.literal: But there are some Jews . . . you have appointed . . . to manage . . . the province of Babylon Shadrach Meshach and Abednego . . . who have ignored . . . . . . you O king and have refused to serve your gods or worship the golden statue you have set up
verses.literalPt: Há uns homens judeus, os quais constituíste sobre os negócios da província de Babilônia: Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego; estes homens, ó rei, não fizeram caso de ti; a teus deuses não servem, nem adoram a estátua de ouro que levantaste.

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֤יִן נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר֙ בִּרְגַ֣ז וַחֲמָ֔ה אֲמַר֙ לְהַיְתָיָ֔ה לְשַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֖ךְ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֑וֹ בֵּאדַ֙יִן֙ גֻּבְרַיָּ֣א אִלֵּ֔ךְ הֵיתָ֖יוּ קֳדָ֥ם מַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar bir·ḡaz wa·ḥă·māh ’ă·mar lə·hay·ṯā·yāh lə·šaḏ·raḵ mê·šaḵ wa·‘ă·ḇêḏ nə·ḡōw bê·ḏa·yin guḇ·ray·yā ’il·lêḵ hê·ṯā·yū qo·ḏām mal·kā
verses.literal: Then Nebuchadnezzar furious with rage summoned . . . Shadrach Meshach and Abednego So these men were brought before the king
verses.literalPt: Então Nabucodonosor, com ira e furor, mandou trazer a Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego. E trouxeram a estes homens perante o rei.

verses.original: עָנֵ֤ה נְבֻֽכַדְנֶצַּר֙ וְאָמַ֣ר לְה֔וֹן הַצְדָּ֕א שַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֖ךְ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֑וֹ לֵֽאלָהַ֗י לָ֤א אִֽיתֵיכוֹן֙ פָּֽלְחִ֔ין וּלְצֶ֧לֶם דַּהֲבָ֛א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ימֶת לָ֥א סָֽגְדִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·nêh nə·ḇu·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar wə·’ā·mar lə·hō·wn haṣ·dā šaḏ·raḵ mê·šaḵ wa·‘ă·ḇêḏ nə·ḡōw lê·lā·hay lā ’î·ṯê·ḵō·wn pā·lə·ḥîn ū·lə·ṣe·lem da·hă·ḇā dî hă·qê·meṯ lā sā·ḡə·ḏîn
verses.literal: and Nebuchadnezzar said to them Shadrach Meshach and Abednego is it true that you do not . . . serve my gods or worship the golden . . . statue I have set up . . .
verses.literalPt: Falou Nabucodonosor, e lhes disse: É de propósito, ó Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego, que vós não servis a meus deuses nem adorais a estátua de ouro que levantei?

verses.original: כְּעַ֞ן הֵ֧ן אִֽיתֵיכ֣וֹן עֲתִידִ֗ין דִּ֣י בְעִדָּנָ֡א דִּֽי־ תִשְׁמְע֡וּן קָ֣ל קַרְנָ֣א מַשְׁרוֹקִיתָ֣א קִיתָרֹס שַׂבְּכָ֡א פְּסַנְתֵּרִין֩ וְסוּמְפֹּ֨נְיָ֜ה וְכֹ֣ל׀ זְנֵ֣י זְמָרָ֗א תִּפְּל֣וּן וְתִסְגְּדוּן֮ לְצַלְמָ֣א דִֽי־ עַבְדֵת֒ וְהֵן֙ לָ֣א תִסְגְּד֔וּן בַּהּ־ שַׁעֲתָ֣ה תִתְרְמ֔וֹן לְגֽוֹא־ אַתּ֥וּן נוּרָ֖א יָקִֽדְתָּ֑א וּמַן־ ה֣וּא אֱלָ֔הּ דֵּ֥י יְשֵֽׁיזְבִנְכ֖וֹן מִן־ יְדָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kə·‘an hên ’î·ṯê·ḵō·wn ‘ă·ṯî·ḏîn dî ḇə·‘id·dā·nā dî- ṯiš·mə·‘ūn qāl qar·nā maš·rō·w·qî·ṯā qī·ṯå̄·rōs śab·bə·ḵā pə·san·tê·rîn wə·sū·mə·pō·nə·yāh wə·ḵōl zə·nê zə·mā·rā tip·pə·lūn wə·ṯis·gə·ḏūn lə·ṣal·mā ḏî- ‘aḇ·ḏêṯ wə·hên lā ṯis·gə·ḏūn bah- ša·‘ă·ṯāh ṯiṯ·rə·mō·wn lə·ḡō·w- ’at·tūn nū·rā yā·qiḏ·tā ū·man- hū ’ĕ·lāh dē yə·šê·zə·ḇin·ḵō·wn min- yə·ḏāy
verses.literal: Now when . . . you hear the sound of the horn flute zither lyre harp pipes and all kinds of music if you are ready to fall down and worship the statue . . . I have made, very good But if you refuse to worship you will be thrown at once into the blazing fiery furnace Then what god will be able to deliver you from my hands
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, se estais prontos, quando ouvirdes o som da buzina, da flauta, da harpa, da sambuca, do saltério, da gaita de foles, e de toda a espécie de música, para vos prostrardes e adorardes a estátua que fiz, bom é; mas, se não a adorardes, sereis lançados, na mesma hora, dentro da fornalha de fogo ardente. E quem é o Deus que vos poderá livrar das minhas mãos?

verses.original: עֲנ֗וֹ שַׁדְרַ֤ךְ מֵישַׁךְ֙ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֔וֹ וְאָמְרִ֖ין לְמַלְכָּ֑א נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּ֔ר לָֽא־ חַשְׁחִ֨ין אֲנַ֧חְנָה עַל־ דְּנָ֛ה פִּתְגָ֖ם לַהֲתָבוּתָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·nōw šaḏ·raḵ mê·šaḵ wa·‘ă·ḇêḏ nə·ḡōw wə·’ā·mə·rîn lə·mal·kā nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar lā- ḥaš·ḥîn ’ă·naḥ·nāh ‘al- də·nāh piṯ·ḡām la·hă·ṯā·ḇū·ṯāḵ
verses.literal: Shadrach Meshach and Abednego . . . replied to the king O Nebuchadnezzar we have no need to answer you in this matter
verses.literalPt: Responderam Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego, e disseram ao rei Nabucodonosor: Não necessitamos de te responder sobre este negócio.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן אִיתַ֗י אֱלָהַ֙נָא֙ דִּֽי־ אֲנַ֣חְנָא פָֽלְחִ֔ין יָכִ֖ל לְשֵׁיזָבוּתַ֑נָא מִן־ אַתּ֨וּן נוּרָ֧א יָקִֽדְתָּ֛א וּמִן־ יְדָ֥ךְ מַלְכָּ֖א יְשֵׁיזִֽב׃
verses.transliteration: hên ’î·ṯay ’ĕ·lā·ha·nā dî- ’ă·naḥ·nā p̄ā·lə·ḥîn yā·ḵil lə·šê·zā·ḇū·ṯa·nā min- ’at·tūn nū·rā yā·qiḏ·tā ū·min- yə·ḏāḵ mal·kā yə·šê·ziḇ
verses.literal: If the God whom we serve exists then He is able to deliver us from the blazing fiery furnace and from your hand O king
verses.literalPt: Eis que o nosso Deus, a quem nós servimos, é que nos pode livrar; ele nos livrará da fornalha de fogo ardente, e da tua mão, ó rei.

verses.original: וְהֵ֣ן לָ֔א יְדִ֥יעַ לֶהֱוֵא־ לָ֖ךְ מַלְכָּ֑א דִּ֤י לֵֽאלָהָיִךְ֙ לָא־ אִיתַיְנָא פָֽלְחִ֔ין וּלְצֶ֧לֶם דַּהֲבָ֛א דִּ֥י הֲקֵ֖ימְתָּ לָ֥א נִסְגֻּֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hên lā yə·ḏî·a‘ le·hĕ·wê- lāḵ mal·kā dî lē·lå̄·hå̄·yiḵ lā- ʾī·ṯay·nå̄ p̄ā·lə·ḥîn ū·lə·ṣe·lem da·hă·ḇā dî hă·qê·mə·tā lā nis·guḏ
verses.literal: But even if He does not let it be known to you O king that we will not . . . serve your gods or worship the golden statue you have set up
verses.literalPt: E, se não, fica sabendo ó rei, que não serviremos a teus deuses nem adoraremos a estátua de ouro que levantaste.

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֨יִן נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֜ר הִתְמְלִ֣י חֱמָ֗א וּצְלֵ֤ם אַנְפּ֙וֹהִי֙ אֶשְׁתַּנּוּ עַל־ שַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֖ךְ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֑וֹ עָנֵ֤ה וְאָמַר֙ לְמֵזֵ֣א לְאַתּוּנָ֔א חַ֨ד־ שִׁבְעָ֔ה עַ֛ל דִּ֥י חֲזֵ֖ה לְמֵזְיֵֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar hiṯ·mə·lî ḥĕ·mā ū·ṣə·lêm ’an·pō·w·hî ʾɛš·tan·nū ‘al- šaḏ·raḵ mê·šaḵ wa·‘ă·ḇêḏ nə·ḡōw ‘ā·nêh wə·’ā·mar lə·mê·zê lə·’at·tū·nā ḥaḏ- šiḇ·‘āh ‘al dî ḥă·zêh lə·mê·zə·yêh
verses.literal: At this Nebuchadnezzar was filled with rage and the expression on his face changed toward Shadrach Meshach and Abednego He gave orders . . . to heat the furnace . . . seven times hotter than usual . . .
verses.literalPt: Então Nabucodonosor se encheu de furor, e mudou-se o aspecto do seu semblante contra Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego; falou, e ordenou que a fornalha se aquecesse sete vezes mais do que se costumava aquecer.

verses.original: וּלְגֻבְרִ֤ין גִּבָּֽרֵי־ חַ֙יִל֙ דִּ֣י בְחַיְלֵ֔הּ אֲמַר֙ לְכַפָּתָ֔ה לְשַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֖ךְ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֑וֹ לְמִרְמֵ֕א לְאַתּ֥וּן נוּרָ֖א יָקִֽדְתָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ḡuḇ·rîn gib·bā·rê- ḥa·yil dî ḇə·ḥay·lêh ’ă·mar lə·ḵap·pā·ṯāh lə·šaḏ·raḵ mê·šaḵ wa·‘ă·ḇêḏ nə·ḡōw lə·mir·mê lə·’at·tūn nū·rā yā·qiḏ·tā
verses.literal: and he commanded some mighty men of valor in his army to tie up Shadrach Meshach and Abednego and throw them into the blazing fiery furnace
verses.literalPt: E ordenou aos homens mais poderosos, que estavam no seu exército, que atassem a Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego, para lançá-los na fornalha de fogo ardente.

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֜יִן גֻּבְרַיָּ֣א אִלֵּ֗ךְ כְּפִ֙תוּ֙ בְּסַרְבָּלֵיהוֹן֙ פַּטִּישֵׁיהוֹן וְכַרְבְּלָתְה֖וֹן וּלְבֻשֵׁיה֑וֹן וּרְמִ֕יו לְגֽוֹא־ אַתּ֥וּן נוּרָ֖א יָקִֽדְתָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin guḇ·ray·yā ’il·lêḵ kə·p̄i·ṯū bə·sar·bā·lê·hō·wn paṭ·ṭī·šē·hōn wə·ḵar·bə·lā·ṯə·hō·wn ū·lə·ḇu·šê·hō·wn ū·rə·mîw lə·ḡō·w- ’at·tūn nū·rā yā·qiḏ·tā
verses.literal: So they . . . were tied up wearing robes trousers turbans and other clothes and they were thrown into the blazing fiery furnace
verses.literalPt: Então estes homens foram atados, vestidos com as suas capas, suas túnicas, e seus chapéus, e demais roupas, e foram lançados dentro da fornalha de fogo ardente.

verses.original: כָּל־ קֳבֵ֣ל דְּנָ֗ה מִן־ דִּ֞י מִלַּ֤ת מַלְכָּא֙ מַחְצְפָ֔ה וְאַתּוּנָ֖א אֵזֵ֣ה יַתִּ֑ירָא גֻּבְרַיָּ֣א אִלֵּ֗ךְ דִּ֤י הַסִּ֙קוּ֙ לְשַׁדְרַ֤ךְ מֵישַׁךְ֙ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֔וֹ קַטִּ֣ל הִמּ֔וֹן שְׁבִיבָ֖א דִּ֥י נוּרָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- qo·ḇêl də·nāh min- dî mil·laṯ mal·kā maḥ·ṣə·p̄āh wə·’at·tū·nā ’ê·zêh yat·tî·rā guḇ·ray·yā ’il·lêḵ dî has·si·qū lə·šaḏ·raḵ mê·šaḵ wa·‘ă·ḇêḏ nə·ḡōw qaṭ·ṭil him·mō·wn šə·ḇî·ḇā dî nū·rā
verses.literal: . . . - The king’s command was so urgent and the furnace so hot that the fiery flames killed . . . the men who carried up Shadrach Meshach and Abednego
verses.literalPt: E, porque a palavra do rei era urgente, e a fornalha estava sobremaneira quente, a chama do fogo matou aqueles homens que carregaram a Sadraque, Mesaque, e Abednego.

verses.original: וְגֻבְרַיָּ֤א אִלֵּךְ֙ תְּלָ֣תֵּה֔וֹן שַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֖ךְ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֑וֹ נְפַ֛לוּ לְגֽוֹא־ אַתּוּן־ נוּרָ֥א יָֽקִדְתָּ֖א מְכַפְּתִֽין׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡuḇ·ray·yā ’il·lêḵ tə·lāt·tê·hō·wn šaḏ·raḵ mê·šaḵ wa·‘ă·ḇêḏ nə·ḡōw nə·p̄a·lū lə·ḡō·w- ’at·tūn- nū·rā yā·qiḏ·tā mə·ḵap·pə·ṯîn
verses.literal: And these three men Shadrach Meshach and Abednego firmly bound fell into the blazing fiery furnace
verses.literalPt: E estes três homens, Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego, caíram atados dentro da fornalha de fogo ardente.

verses.original: אֱדַ֙יִן֙ נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֣ר מַלְכָּ֔א תְּוַ֖הּ וְקָ֣ם בְּהִתְבְּהָלָ֑ה עָנֵ֨ה וְאָמַ֜ר לְהַדָּֽבְר֗וֹהִי הֲלָא֩ גֻבְרִ֨ין תְּלָתָ֜א רְמֵ֤ינָא לְגוֹא־ נוּרָא֙ מְכַפְּתִ֔ין עָנַ֤יִן וְאָמְרִין֙ לְמַלְכָּ֔א יַצִּיבָ֖א מַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏa·yin nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar mal·kā tə·wah wə·qām bə·hiṯ·bə·hā·lāh ‘ā·nêh wə·’ā·mar lə·had·dā·ḇə·rō·w·hî hă·lā ḡuḇ·rîn tə·lā·ṯā rə·mê·nā lə·ḡō·w- nū·rā mə·ḵap·pə·ṯîn ‘ā·na·yin wə·’ā·mə·rîn lə·mal·kā yaṣ·ṣî·ḇā mal·kā
verses.literal: Suddenly King . . . Nebuchadnezzar jumped up in amazement and asked his advisers Did we not throw three men firmly bound into the fire Certainly O king they replied . . .
verses.literalPt: Então o rei Nabucodonosor se espantou, e se levantou depressa; falou, dizendo aos seus conselheiros: Não lançamos nós, dentro do fogo, três homens atados? Responderam e disseram ao rei: É verdade, ó rei.

verses.original: עָנֵ֣ה וְאָמַ֗ר הָֽא־ אֲנָ֨ה חָזֵ֜ה גֻּבְרִ֣ין אַרְבְּעָ֗ה שְׁרַ֙יִן֙ מַהְלְכִ֣ין בְּגֽוֹא־ נוּרָ֔א וַחֲבָ֖ל לָא־ אִיתַ֣י בְּה֑וֹן וְרֵוֵהּ֙ דִּ֣י רְבִיעָיָא דָּמֵ֖ה לְבַר־ אֱלָהִֽין׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·nêh wə·’ā·mar hā- ’ă·nāh ḥā·zêh guḇ·rîn ’ar·bə·‘āh šə·ra·yin mah·lə·ḵîn bə·ḡō·w- nū·rā wa·ḥă·ḇāl lā- ’î·ṯay bə·hō·wn wə·rê·wêh dî rə·ḇī·ʿå̄·yå̄ dā·mêh lə·ḇar- ’ĕ·lā·hîn
verses.literal: Look . . . he exclaimed I see four men unbound and unharmed . . . . . . walking around in the fire and the fourth looks . . . like a son of the gods
verses.literalPt: Respondeu, dizendo: Eu, porém, vejo quatro homens soltos, que andam passeando dentro do fogo, sem sofrer nenhum dano; e o aspecto do quarto é semelhante ao Filho de Deus.

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֜יִן קְרֵ֣ב נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֗ר לִתְרַע֮ אַתּ֣וּן נוּרָ֣א יָקִֽדְתָּא֒ עָנֵ֣ה וְאָמַ֗ר שַׁדְרַ֨ךְ מֵישַׁ֧ךְ וַעֲבֵד־ נְג֛וֹ עַבְד֛וֹהִי דִּֽי־ אֱלָהָ֥א עִלָּיָא פֻּ֣קוּ וֶאֱת֑וֹ בֵּאדַ֣יִן נָֽפְקִ֗ין שַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֛ךְ וַעֲבֵ֥ד נְג֖וֹ מִן־ גּ֥וֹא נוּרָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin qə·rêḇ nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar liṯ·ra‘ ’at·tūn nū·rā yā·qiḏ·tā ‘ā·nêh wə·’ā·mar šaḏ·raḵ mê·šaḵ wa·‘ă·ḇêḏ- nə·ḡōw ‘aḇ·ḏō·w·hî dî- ’ĕ·lā·hā ʿil·lå̄·yå̄ pu·qū we·’ĕ·ṯōw bê·ḏa·yin nā·p̄ə·qîn šaḏ·raḵ mê·šaḵ wa·‘ă·ḇêḏ nə·ḡōw min- gō·w nū·rā
verses.literal: Then Nebuchadnezzar approached the door of the blazing fiery furnace . . . and called out Shadrach Meshach and Abednego servants . . . of the Most High God come out . . . So Shadrach Meshach and Abednego came out of . . . the fire
verses.literalPt: Então chegando-se Nabucodonosor à porta da fornalha de fogo ardente, falou, dizendo: Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego, servos do Deus Altíssimo, saí e vinde! Então Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego saíram do meio do fogo.

verses.original: וּ֠מִֽתְכַּנְּשִׁין אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֞א סִגְנַיָּ֣א וּפַחֲוָתָא֮ וְהַדָּבְרֵ֣י מַלְכָּא֒ חָזַ֣יִן לְגֻבְרַיָּ֣א אִלֵּ֡ךְ דִּי֩ לָֽא־ שְׁלֵ֨ט נוּרָ֜א בְּגֶשְׁמְה֗וֹן וּשְׂעַ֤ר רֵֽאשְׁהוֹן֙ לָ֣א הִתְחָרַ֔ךְ וְסָרְבָּלֵיה֖וֹן לָ֣א שְׁנ֑וֹ וְרֵ֣יחַ נ֔וּר לָ֥א עֲדָ֖ת בְּהֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miṯ·kan·nə·šîn ’ă·ḥaš·dar·pə·nay·yā siḡ·nay·yā ū·p̄a·ḥă·wā·ṯā wə·had·dā·ḇə·rê mal·kā ḥā·za·yin lə·ḡuḇ·ray·yā ’il·lêḵ dî lā- šə·lêṭ nū·rā bə·ḡeš·mə·hō·wn ū·śə·‘ar rê·šə·hō·wn lā hiṯ·ḥā·raḵ wə·sā·rə·bā·lê·hō·wn lā šə·nōw wə·rê·aḥ nūr lā ‘ă·ḏāṯ bə·hō·wn
verses.literal: and when the satraps prefects governors and royal advisers had gathered around they saw that the fire had no effect on the bodies of these . . . men Not a hair of their heads was singed their robes were unaffected . . . and there was no . . . smell of fire on them
verses.literalPt: E reuniram-se os príncipes, os capitães, os governadores e os conselheiros do rei e, contemplando estes homens, viram que o fogo não tinha tido poder algum sobre os seus corpos; nem um só cabelo da sua cabeça se tinha queimado, nem as suas capas se mudaram, nem cheiro de fogo tinha passado sobre eles.

verses.original: עָנֵ֨ה נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּ֜ר וְאָמַ֗ר בְּרִ֤יךְ אֱלָהֲהוֹן֙ דִּֽי־ שַׁדְרַ֤ךְ מֵישַׁךְ֙ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֔וֹ דִּֽי־ שְׁלַ֤ח מַלְאֲכֵהּ֙ וְשֵׁיזִ֣ב לְעַבְד֔וֹהִי דִּ֥י הִתְרְחִ֖צוּ עֲל֑וֹהִי וּמִלַּ֤ת מַלְכָּא֙ שַׁנִּ֔יו וִיהַ֣בוּ גֶשְׁמֵיהוֹן דִּ֠י לָֽא־ יִפְלְח֤וּן וְלָֽא־ יִסְגְּדוּן֙ לְכָל־ אֱלָ֔הּ לָהֵ֖ן לֵאלָֽהֲהֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·nêh nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar wə·’ā·mar bə·rîḵ ’ĕ·lā·hă·hō·wn dî- šaḏ·raḵ mê·šaḵ wa·‘ă·ḇêḏ nə·ḡōw dî- šə·laḥ mal·’ă·ḵêh wə·šê·ziḇ lə·‘aḇ·ḏō·w·hî dî hiṯ·rə·ḥi·ṣū ‘ă·lō·w·hî ū·mil·laṯ mal·kā šan·nîw wî·ha·ḇū ḡɛš·mē·hōn dî lā- yip̄·lə·ḥūn wə·lā- yis·gə·ḏūn lə·ḵāl ’ĕ·lāh lā·hên lê·lā·hă·hō·wn
verses.literal: Nebuchadnezzar . . . declared Blessed be the God of Shadrach Meshach and Abednego who has sent His angel and delivered His servants . . . who trusted in Him They violated . . . the king’s command and risked their lives . . . . . . rather than serve . . . or worship any god except their own God
verses.literalPt: Falou Nabucodonosor, dizendo: Bendito seja o Deus de Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego, que enviou o seu anjo, e livrou os seus servos, que confiaram nele, pois violaram a palavra do rei, preferindo entregar os seus corpos, para que não servissem nem adorassem algum outro deus, senão o seu Deus.

verses.original: וּמִנִּי֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ דִּי֩ כָל־ עַ֨ם אֻמָּ֜ה וְלִשָּׁ֗ן דִּֽי־ יֵאמַ֤ר שֵׁלָה עַ֣ל אֱלָהֲה֗וֹן דִּֽי־ שַׁדְרַ֤ךְ מֵישַׁךְ֙ וַעֲבֵ֣ד נְג֔וֹא הַדָּמִ֣ין יִתְעֲבֵ֔ד וּבַיְתֵ֖הּ נְוָלִ֣י יִשְׁתַּוֵּ֑ה כָּל־ קֳבֵ֗ל דִּ֣י לָ֤א אִיתַי֙ אֱלָ֣ה אָחֳרָ֔ן דִּֽי־ יִכֻּ֥ל לְהַצָּלָ֖ה כִּדְנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min·nî śîm ṭə·‘êm dî ḵāl ‘am ’um·māh wə·liš·šān dî- yê·mar šē·lå̄h ‘al ’ĕ·lā·hă·hō·wn dî- šaḏ·raḵ mê·šaḵ wa·‘ă·ḇêḏ nə·ḡō·w had·dā·mîn yiṯ·‘ă·ḇêḏ ū·ḇay·ṯêh nə·wā·lî yiš·taw·wêh kāl- qo·ḇêl dî lā ’î·ṯay ’ĕ·lāh ’ā·ḥo·rān dî- yik·kul lə·haṣ·ṣā·lāh kiḏ·nāh
verses.literal: Therefore I decree . . . that the people of any nation or language who say anything offensive against the God of Shadrach Meshach and Abednego will be cut into pieces and their houses reduced . . . to rubble For . . . there is no other god who can deliver in this way
verses.literalPt: Por mim, pois, é feito um decreto, pelo qual todo o povo, e nação e língua que disser blasfêmia contra o Deus de Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego, seja despedaçado, e as suas casas sejam feitas um monturo; porquanto não há outro Deus que possa livrar como este.

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֣יִן מַלְכָּ֗א הַצְלַ֛ח לְשַׁדְרַ֥ךְ מֵישַׁ֛ךְ וַעֲבֵ֥ד נְג֖וֹ בִּמְדִינַ֥ת בָּבֶֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin mal·kā haṣ·laḥ lə·šaḏ·raḵ mê·šaḵ wa·‘ă·ḇêḏ nə·ḡōw bim·ḏî·naṯ bā·ḇel
verses.literal: Then the king promoted Shadrach Meshach and Abednego in the province of Babylon
verses.literalPt: Então o rei fez prosperar a Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego, na província de Babilônia.
